description: This file contains utility functions and constants for screenshot testing in an Android Jetpack Compose environment. It includes setup for multi-device and multi-theme screenshot capture, accessibility checks integration, device specification parsing, and related configuration objects.

classes.name: TestDeviceSpecs
classes.description: Data class representing device specifications such as width, height, and dpi extracted from device spec strings.

methods.name: captureMultiDevice
methods.description: Captures screenshots across multiple predefined device configurations, optionally checking accessibility.

methods.name: captureForDevice
methods.description: Sets up device-specific environment and captures screenshots, running accessibility checks beforehand.

methods.name: captureMultiTheme
methods.description: Takes screenshots under various theme combinations (light/dark, default/dynamic/Android) to test UI consistency.

methods.name: generateDescription
methods.description: Constructs a descriptive label for screenshot filenames based on theme and mode toggles.

methods.name: extractSpecs
methods.description: Parses a device specification string to extract width, height, and dpi values.
